rule: In profile_export_aiperf.json the fields artifacts.dir, tokenizer.name, run_info.cli_command and, for profile S, datasets[].path, and in levels.jsonl the entries of the command list: the local user-home prefix (drive letter, Users, user name; forward or back slashes) is replaced by <HOME>. Every other byte is unchanged. Originals are kept locally, outside version control. The same rule and the same <HOME> token were applied in B3'' to the server_metrics_export.json files (fields input_config.artifacts.dir, input_config.tokenizer.name, input_config.datasets[].path); their server_metrics_export.csv siblings carry no local path and are committed byte-identical to what AIPerf wrote.

files.note: no local path present, so no field was de-identified. The committed SHA-256 differs from the original because git normalises the CRLF line endings AIPerf writes to LF on the way into the repository (core.autocrlf=true, no .gitattributes); the content is otherwise unchanged. This applies to every AIPerf .csv in this tree, including the profile_export_aiperf.csv files committed earlier.
